newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM MAY BID FOR REPAP IF NO MERGER - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: UPM MAY BID FOR REPAP IF NO MERGER - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish UPM-Kymmene is likely to bid for Canadian LWC paper maker Repap should shareholders of Repap and Avenor reject the planned merger of the two, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Tuesday.

It quoted an unnamed UPM-Kymmene source as saying that a new bid was likely should there be a chance for it and said UPM had already offered to buy Repap at the end of last year. Nobody at UPM-Kymmene was immediately available for comment.
The paper said shareholders of Canadian Avenor and Repap were due to vote on a proposed merger on Wednesday, but that the outcome was uncertain.

Repap's past strategy to buy undervalued paper and pulp mills and modernise them with debt financing had given it modern machinery and a leading position in light-weight-coated paper in North America, Kauppalehti said.
Its downsides are its debts and pulp production, it said.
